messages.text:
I can’t add shipping to the rack’s price: the item refund is limited to what you paid for it, excluding shipping (refund-policy/v2/amount). Staff cannot approve an inflated item refund either (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

You can request the rack-only refund of BRL 119.00. Would you like that? For shipping, would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge? It cannot be refunded automatically (refund-policy/v2/shipping).
